## English

Waifu2x Desktop 1.0.2 adds compact native Settings, model repair, and verified incremental downloads.

### New
- Choose the app language and appearance in Settings, revisit the tutorial, and check for app updates
- Check application and model integrity, view model status and storage usage, and repair missing or damaged models
- Download compatible app updates and model repairs incrementally, with verified full packages as fallback
- Enable background batch completion notifications and prevent idle sleep only while enhancement is running
- Copy privacy-preserving diagnostic information from About

### Improved
- Smooth transitions between model preparation, the tutorial, and the workspace
- Routine model verification stays behind the splash on later launches
- Download progress uses transferred bytes instead of an outdated file counter
- Compact Settings centers over the main window, closes on focus loss, and toggles with Command-comma
- Refined dark appearance and layouts for all seven supported languages

**Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 26 or later**

Download the DMG or ZIP to install. The app downloads models when needed; model archives and repair files are managed automatically. App updates are verified and prepared separately; use Show Update in Finder, quit the app, then replace the installed copy.

The app uses an ad-hoc signature and is not Developer ID signed or notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch and you trust the download, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Image processing stays on your Mac.

## 简体中文

Waifu2x Desktop 1.0.2 新增紧凑的原生设置窗口、模型修复与经过校验的增量下载。

### 新增
- 在设置中选择语言、外观，重新查看教程并检查软件更新
- 检查应用与模型完整性，查看模型状态和实际占用空间，直接修复缺失或损坏的模型
- 应用更新与模型修复支持增量下载，不满足条件时回退到经过校验的完整包
- 可开启后台批量增强完成通知，仅在增强运行期间防止 Mac 自动睡眠
- 在关于页复制不含个人路径和图片名称的诊断信息

### 改进
- 优化模型准备、教程与工作区之间的转场
- 后续启动时在开屏下完成常规模型校验，不再闪现安装界面
- 下载进度按实际传输字节显示，移除过时的文件计数
- 设置窗口每次打开时居中于主窗口，失焦关闭，Command-comma 可切换开关
- 优化深色外观与七种语言的紧凑排版

**支持 Apple Silicon（arm64），要求 macOS 26 或更高版本**

下载 DMG 或 ZIP 安装即可。模型归档和修复文件由应用按需自动管理，无需手动安装。软件更新会在独立目录完成下载与校验，选择“在 Finder 中查看更新”后退出应用，再替换已安装的版本。

应用使用 ad-hoc 临时签名，未使用 Developer ID 签名，未经 Apple 公证。若 macOS 阻止首次打开，且你信任此下载，可通过“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开”启动。图片处理始终在 Mac 本机完成。
